verdict.rationale: CrewAI's docs say its YAML configuration lets you version-control agent settings, and crews and flows are defined as code and config files that can live in a repository. That covers the versioning part of the story only indirectly, through your own source control. Nothing in the pack shows built-in review workflows, deployment version history, or rollback, whether in the open-source framework or in AMP/Crew Studio. Missing for 10: native versioning of automations, review/approval of changes, rollback of deployed crews or flows, and independent corroboration.
